contract.rule: If this file and the contract differ, the contract wins and the fix is a dated amendment.

known_truth.KT4: NDSU target boxes (claimed until H1); not split
known_truth.KT7: iNaturalist Research Grade, <=30 per taxon, CC photos, evaluation-only

backends.RL-A: claude-opus-5-5 (vision); pool and known-truth crops only

reference_labeller.task: blind multiple choice: 12 targets + stratum attractors + other plant + not a plant + box invalid + unsure
reference_labeller.primary_rule: qualified backend with the larger sum of Se and Sp lower bounds at the needed level; tie -> RL-B

sampling.name_status: name_status_v2 frozen at F3 before F6

estimators.rl_error: Rogan-Gladen, melded intervals; flag if Se+Sp-1<0.7
estimators.clustering: cluster bootstrap by image, 2000 resamples; by source across sources

H0.b: relation audit (names hidden) maps cottonweed_holdout and three_season-2021 classes with >=20 boxes to true species; flags cottonweed_holdout old join; does not flag cottonweed_sp8 current join

hypotheses.H1_pre: NDSU label ids agree with upstream Mendeley annotations by geometry

H1.measure: RL precision (label right and box valid) of non-verified NDSU target boxes

H3a.alignments: identity, +-1, 16 drop-class-d maps; chosen on a seeded half, confirmed on the other
H3a.falsified: agreement <0.99 under every alignment, or a purity LB <0.6

H3b.frame: anonymous sources other than mh_weed16 with >=100 embedded boxes
H3b.supported: some class or visual cluster has target-prevalence LB>=0.5

H5a.exact: dropped exact_dup twins carrying a target box the kept twin lacks < 100 boxes

H5b.supported: >=0.8 of non-cwd12 near_eval hits are the same photo or a consecutive frame

H6.detector: DINOv2 descriptors + dHash of flip/rotate variants

calibration.positives: train_core augmented (flip, rot90, crop 0-20%, brightness +-25%, blur, shear, letterbox 640, JPEG)

H6.scope: 14 sources with near_eval hits + base B + realloop_v1 increments
H6.routing: a source with a detected copy is quarantined from recovery as a whole; a copy in B voids C1 and rebuilds B

hypotheses.H7: J-zs and J-knn1 fail qualification on KT7/KT2; J-knn2 qualifies

H8.supported: RL-confirmed shifted recall +>=0.20 abs, in-domain precision >=0.99, named-relative conflicts -50% on held-out-lab strata

H9_prime.quantity: LB of sum N_h*precision_h over admitted strata with precision LB>=0.85

H10a.rule: gate.truth_detail helps (P>=0.75 and species guard) AND one-sided exact permutation p<=0.025 at 5 v 5 seeds

hypotheses.H10c: >=1 M-size recovery increment helps and beats its same-image control P>=0.75

H11.supported: DA top-1 stage == stage with largest R-hat LB, and log-loss beats uniform over recoverable stages

H12.supported: >=0.70 of known-item datasets present in registry

recovery_gates.ragweed_identity_check: 30 train_core Ragweed crops are A. artemisiifolia before any NDSU Ragweed is recovered

diagnoses.D17: scarcity_conclusion_unaudited: conclusion AND any of S1-S7 AND no matching audit

signals.S3_class_yield: verified share <0.25 x median over classes with >=100 name-joined boxes

stop_rules: H6b copy -> R4 incident before F9; C1 void, B rebuilt
never-train hit in a recovered set -> stop F9
no RL qualifies for a genus -> hypotheses about it bounded
